result: Verified MKV playback and per-channel track selection for the tested combination. Full extended-format qualification remains open.

combination.audio: Two distinguishable stereo PCM s16le streams at 48 kHz

baseline.observed: Video stream duration unavailable with an 8-second video and a 12-second container

audioChecks: Automatic follows the default-tagged right track.
The Inspector lists both stream titles and languages. A live change moved PCM to the left output while Video position advanced from 2011 ms to 2433 ms.
An unavailable exact selection silences the channel. Selecting a valid track restores audio while playback continues.
Both channel choices persisted after reload, and the selected track was audible.
subtitleChecks: Both embedded tracks were discovered with title and language.
Two channels using the same MKV showed English and French simultaneously on two independently sampled Spout outputs.
Changing the second channel preserved the first output pixel for pixel.
Held crop/seek respects source cue bounds, and both channel selections preserved their exact pixels after reload.

remaining: Further MKV codec and profile combinations. Moving captions, audio/video sync across loops, and bundled recovery and performance qualification.
